channel.title: Violations Watch: Pakistan
channel.description: New incidents reported in Pakistan. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Unidentified armed men set a contractor's truck on fire and abduct two people, including its driver, in South Waziristan (Dawn)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). South Waziristan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Types: Abduction & hostage-taking, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed men. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2540

item.title: Drone strike on two homes in Washuk district, Balochistan, reportedly wounds an elderly civilian, local sources say (Tribune/ANI)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Mulla Dhuni village, Raghai area, Washuk district, Balochistan, Pakistan. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Pakistani forces (alleged). Reported casualties: 0 killed, 1 injured. Disputed or caveats: armed-group-linked or partisan source, not verified ANI copy citing The Balochistan Post and local sources. No official Pakistani statement. The date is inferred: the strike was 'Thursday' and the article is dated 27 Nov. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2394

item.title: Police detain senior JUI-F leaders, including an MNA, in Sargodha, and bar party chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman and eight other leaders from the district for 30 days amid JUI-F highway protests (Dawn)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Sargodha, Punjab, Pakistan. Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Punjab police and district authorities. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2387

item.title: Drone strike in Mastung, Balochistan, on 21 Nov kills one man and wounds two children, the Baloch Yakjehti Committee says (Tribune/ANI)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Mastung, Balochistan, Pakistan. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Pakistani forces (alleged). Reported casualties: 1 killed, 2 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: armed-group-linked or partisan source, not verified; allegation by the Baloch Yakjehti Committee; no independent confirmation found ANI syndicated copy citing the BYC. It says the man was critically injured in the 21 Nov strike and later died. No official statement. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2228

item.title: Two successive drone attacks hit a peace jirga in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, injuring 10
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified (drone attack). Reported casualties: 10 injured. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1800

item.title: Pakistan: TV anchor Iqrarul Hassan charged with cyberterrorism over social media posts the authorities call "anti-state", after his arrest by the NCCIA last month (Dawn)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan. Types: Attacks on journalists, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Pakistani authorities (NCCIA, judiciary). 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1426

item.title: Pakistan: human rights lawyers Imaan Mazari-Hazir and Hadi Ali Chattha, detained since January for their peaceful activism, convicted again on charges Amnesty calls trumped up
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Islamabad, Pakistan. Types: Persecution & repression, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Pakistani authorities. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1425

item.title: Journalist Shahid Maitla is handed to the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency on a two-day transit remand to Quetta under the electronic crimes law (PECA) over X posts a former caretaker prime minister says defamed him; HRCP and PFUJ condemn the arrest (Voicepk)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Islamabad, Islamabad Capital Territory, Pakistan. Types: Attacks on journalists, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (on a complaint by Anwaar-ul-Haq Kakar). Disputed or caveats: Exact arrest date not stated; the journalists' union says unidentified persons seized him. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1289

item.title: Police detain former KP ministers Taimur Jhagra and Kamran Bangash and PTI Peshawar president Irfan Saleem under public-order detention powers at the Peshawar High Court, minutes after the court granted them interim bail (Dawn, Express Tribune)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Peshawar district administration and police. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1288

item.title: Pakistan-administered Kashmir: three young men killed in clashes with army and Rangers in Rawalakot; activist accuses army of repression
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Rawalakot, Pakistan-administered Kashmir, AJK. Types: Killing of civilians, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Pakistan Army and Rangers (alleged). Reported casualties: 3-7 killed, 23 injured. Disputed or caveats: Activist claims far higher tolls (119 killed); partisan sources on both sides. 7 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0003
